messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social behaviour and attitudes, Crime and law enforcement, International politics and organisations, Conflict, security and peace, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, Elections, Economic conditions and indicators, Economic policy, public expenditure and revenue, and Economic systems and development in Berlin, Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Bremen, Hesse, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein during the 1990s, matching this research need: Monthly cumulative survey data on voting-age Germans’ political opinions, party and politician evaluations, voting behavior, and current issues, including separate East and West Germany samples and short surveys from 2003 onward.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS Politbarometer cumulative monthly 1990 2003 short surveys East West Germany dataset
ZA Politbarometer kumuliert 1977 2024 Kurzpolitbarometer 2003 dataset GESIS
action.query: GESIS Politbarometer cumulative monthly 1990 2003 short surveys East West Germany dataset

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Politbarometer 1977–2024 (Partial Cumulation) – GESIS ZA2391","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.14611","justification":"Best overall match. This longitudinal dataset combines selected variables from approximately monthly Politbarometer surveys conducted by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen for ZDF. It covers the entire 1990s and includes political opinions, voting intentions, party preferences, evaluations of politicians, electoral behavior, government performance, economic conditions, and major political issues. The series includes separate East and West German surveys for 1990–1995 and from 1999 onward. Geographic identifiers include federal states, supporting analysis of Berlin, Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Bremen, Hesse, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein, subject to sample availability. The partial cumulation contains a selected set of recurring variables rather than every question asked in the original surveys."},{"title":"GESIS Politbarometer – Annual Cumulative Survey Datasets (1977–2025)","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/elections/politbarometer","justification":"Official GESIS collection providing annual cumulative datasets of the Politbarometer surveys. Each annual dataset combines approximately monthly representative surveys of Germany's voting-age population and retains the questions and variables collected that year. Topics include voting behavior, party and politician evaluations, political attitudes, government performance, economic policy, international affairs, security, and current events. Separate Politbarometer East and West surveys are available for 1990–1995 and from 1999 onward. From 2003, additional short Politbarometer surveys are incorporated into the annual cumulative files. This collection is particularly suitable for researchers requiring the complete monthly survey content rather than selected longitudinal indicators."},{"title":"GESIS Politbarometer Research Data Catalogue – Annual Cumulations and Historical Surveys","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/?study_group=Politbarometer&type=research_data","justification":"Official research data catalogue containing individual Politbarometer datasets, including annual cumulations from the 1990s, separate East and West German surveys, and later surveys incorporating short questionnaires. Enables researchers to locate year-specific datasets and documentation covering party preferences, politician evaluations, voting intentions, government satisfaction, social attitudes, crime, international politics, economic conditions, and major public issues. Particularly useful for assembling a detailed 1990–1999 monthly survey dataset while preserving the full range of questions asked in individual years."},{"title":"Politbarometer East 1993 (Cumulated Data Set) – GESIS ZA2390","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.2390","justification":"Directly relevant historical dataset containing the cumulative Politbarometer East surveys conducted in 1993. Covers voting intentions in federal and state elections, previous electoral behavior, party preferences, evaluations of political parties and politicians, and major political issues. Provides a complementary eastern German sample for comparative analysis with western German surveys. Especially useful for studying political attitudes during the early post-reunification period, although its eastern geographic coverage does not directly match most of the specified western federal states."},{"title":"1998 Election Study (Politbarometer) – GESIS","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3160","justification":"Historical cumulative dataset combining monthly Politbarometer surveys from 1998, a significant federal election year in Germany. Covers voting-age Germans' political opinions, party and politician evaluations, electoral preferences, voting behavior, and current political issues. Relevant to research on political attitudes and electoral change in the specified German federal states during the late 1990s. The 1998 surveys precede the resumption of separately conducted East and West Politbarometer surveys in 1999."},{"title":"Politbarometer West 2003 (Cumulated Data Set, Including Short Politbarometer Surveys) – GESIS ZA4004","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.4004","justification":"Highly relevant methodological and temporal extension of the 1990s Politbarometer series. Combines the regular 2003 Politbarometer West surveys with additional short Politbarometer questionnaires introduced into annual cumulative datasets from 2003 onward. Covers political opinions, party and politician evaluations, voting behavior, and current issues among the voting-age population. Particularly relevant to the specified western German federal states, including Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Bremen, Hesse, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein, as well as western Berlin where represented. Although outside the requested 1990s period, it directly matches the requirement for short surveys from 2003 onward and supports longitudinal extensions."}]}
